result.title: Prescribed Bayesian Efficiency under Lifetime Adjustment Costs
result.summary: A Bayesian learner may retain an issued action while updating its posterior, trading predictive loss against adjustment charges. We assume population curvature, boundary control, an order-$1/n$ lower bound on expected posterior uncertainty about the optimal action, and an observable unbiased gradient witness whose squared norms are uniformly integrable. Sample losses may be unbounded or nonconvex. Cumulative expected excess measures the loss increase relative to current predictive Bayes actions. For bounded nonnegative nondecreasing charges $c$ with $c(0)=0$ and nondecreasing profiles $G: \mathbb{N} \to [1,\infty)$ with $G(J)=o(J)$, we characterize joint attainability of cumulative expected excess $O(G(J))$ at horizons $T=2^J$ and finite expected lifetime charge. Here $J$ indexes logarithmic time. The criterion is finiteness of a prefix-constrained allocation of tracking-error allowances across action-distance scales, equivalently its decreasing-weight dual. Adaptive timing and private randomization do not enlarge the attainable region. For each feasible pair, a horizon-independent deterministic checkpoint policy attains the profile with lifetime-cost moments of every positive order. For excess $O((\log T)^r)$, $0<r<1$, every policy needs $Ω((\log T)^{2-r})$ revisions in expectation, and a charge-independent schedule achieves a matching pathwise upper bound for every feasible charge. We verify the assumptions for logistic decision models with nondegenerate covariates, finite second moments and a locally positive smooth prior density, including fixed-ridge models with unbounded parameter priors.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在贝叶斯学习框架下研究学习者在持续更新后验的同时保留已发出动作、并在调整成本约束下的效率问题：刻画累积超额损失 O(G(J)) 与有限期望终身成本能否同时达到，给出与时间尺度无关的 checkpoint 策略，并证明超额为 O((log T)^r) 时所需修订次数的下界。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「保留旧动作还是付出成本更新」的权衡、修订次数下界与 checkpoint 调度，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新频率、计算–收益折中及何时继续更新或停止提供形式化类比，可供核查迁移价值。
